result.description:
Shape the future of complex engineering programs in a high-visibility configuration management role.   
   An innovative and growing Australian engineering organisation is seeking an experienced Configuration Manager to lead, mature and continuously improve configuration management across complex systems, equipment and software programs. This is a hands-on, high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys building structure, driving governance and partnering closely with engineering, project and delivery teams.   
   
  Your New Company  
   
 This is a rare opportunity to join a forward-thinking engineering business with a strong reputation for technical excellence, innovation and long-term project delivery. Based in a beautiful location, the organisation offers the best of both worlds: meaningful, visible project work within a supportive environment that values collaboration, capability uplift and career development. 
   
 You will be surrounded by excellent leadership and mentorship, with genuine access to senior decision-makers, clear progression pathways and the opportunity to make your mark on projects that matter. 
   
  Your New Role  
   
 As Configuration Manager, you will take ownership of the configuration management framework across complex engineering programs. This role blends strategic governance with practical delivery, giving you the autonomy to shape processes while remaining close to the technical detail. 
 
 Own, maintain and continuously improve configuration management policies, processes, procedures and tools. 
 Establish and govern configuration baselines across the full system lifecycle. 
 Lead configuration control activities, including Change Control Boards. 
 Manage engineering change processes, configuration status accounting and configuration audits. 
 Maintain accurate configuration records, drawings, specifications and associated technical data. 
 Provide practical CM guidance to engineering, project and delivery teams. 
 Support compliance with relevant defence, engineering and industry standards. 
 
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 
 Significant configuration management experience within defence, aerospace or complex engineering environments. 
 Experience developing and implementing CM frameworks, policies and procedures. 
 Strong understanding of configuration data, baselines and engineering change processes. 
 Knowledge of relevant CM standards such as EIA-649, MIL-HDBK-61, ISO, ITIL or equivalent. 
 Hands-on experience using CM or PLM tools; Windchill experience will be highly regarded. 
 Ability to operate strategically while also supporting hands-on delivery. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement skills across technical and project teams. 
 A degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT or a related discipline. 
 
  What's in it for you  
 
 Excellent leadership, mentorship and support from experienced senior leaders. 
 Clear progression opportunities within a growing and highly visible organisation. 
 Exposure to complex, meaningful engineering projects with genuine technical depth. 
 The chance to shape and improve configuration management capability from the ground up. 
 A collaborative, innovative and dynamic working environment. 
 Beautiful location with access to an enviable lifestyle and engaging project work. 
 Strong company visibility, where your contribution will be recognised and valued. 
 
  What to do now:  
   
 If you are a hands-on Configuration Manager looking for a role with autonomy, visibility, mentorship and long-term career growth, this is an opportunity worth exploring. 
   
 Apply now or send your CV directly to Amy McNulty directly at   amy.mcnulty@hays.com.au    
     Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
About Us

JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon.

JBS Australia’s Northern Division operates five strategically placed processing facilities as well as five feedlots across Queensland and New South Wales, with access to an extensive network of quality cattle. Our network provides the ability to meet the specific demands of various market segments with an extensive range of grain-fed and pasture-fed products. With approximately 15,000 employees spread across our offices, processing plants and feedlots, JBS Australia exports to more than 50 countries around the world.

About the Role

An exciting opportunity is opening for a maintenance planner for our Dinmore Site, it is a full-time role and responsible for our Dinmore site Maintenance related tasks. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

The maintenance planer is responsible for a wide range of engineering and maintenance activities associated with the operations of multiple cattle feedlots. The maintenance planner develops and implements long-term and short-term maintenance plans for all mechanical and electrical equipment to optimize feedlot safety, quality, equipment availability, and reliability outcomes. The role provides direction and guidance to the feedlot maintenance team members to ensure the safe and efficient maintenance and repair of the electrical and mechanical assets. Additionally, the role identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities in processes, systems, and equipment, and manages nominated capital projects.

Reporting to the plant engineer, this is a leadership position within the maintenance team. The position is hands-on, requires extensive maintenance and equipment knowledge, provides equipment solutions using sound maintenance principles, and requires the ability to lead and develop maintenance crew team members.

 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

· Facilitate maintenance to ensure production requirements are met.

· Ensure all requested and scheduled tasks are investigated, planned, executed, completed, and closed out on time and on budget.

· Prepare and order necessary spare parts and materials for planned tasks.

· Monitor spare parts holdings and the condition of critical spares.

· Develop and maintain the sap pm equipment register (functional locations).

· Monitor maintenance employee timesheets and follow up on any comments and recommendations.

· Plan, schedule, and monitor completion of maintenance work orders.

· Program and ensure all statutory requirements are met.

· Plan, schedule, and coordinate all major repair tasks in conjunction with the feedlot engineer.

· Ensure all documentation and schematics are securely retained, updated, and maintained as required.

· Coordinate teams of trades and non-trades personnel and external contractors.

· Ensure company procedures are supported and adhered to, i.e., permits to work, hot work permits, isolation and locking out, risk assessments, live work procedures, incident reporting, etc.

· Support, coordinate, and control ongoing maintenance and capital works planning and coordination functions for all areas of the feedlot.

· Facilitate and develop the processes required to analyze downtime.

· Produce actions to fix root cause and prevent failures from reoccurring.

· Development of effective contractor management systems including performance auditing.

· Assist in the delivery of projects and maintenance services.

· Implement minor projects and commissioning.

· Resolve issues and improve the existing and future feedlot systems.

· Develop systems and practices to maximize the benefit of the sap pm maintenance management system.

· Communicate with operations personnel on maintenance issues.

· Provide in-house training to other staff on the planning and scheduling systems.

· Organize and schedule maintenance training as required.

· Provide information for maintenance management reporting.

· Dealing with a multitude of tasks and demands at the one time with limited resources.

· Dealing with a wide range of people with varying levels of skills.

· Identifying and implementing solutions to quickly address feedlot breakdowns.

About you:

· A thorough understanding of work planning and scheduling procedures using sap pm.

· A thorough understanding of maintenance work management practices.

· Advanced electrical or mechanical trade or post-trade qualifications and experience.

· Experience in maintenance in a feedlot environment, desired but not essential.

· Proven ability to lead, manage, and motivate employees.

· The ability to lead and motivate people to continuously improve.

· Experience gained from a large heavy industrial organization.

· Extensive computer skills.

· Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills.

· Effective problem-solving capacity.

· Sound knowledge of OH&S regulations.

The ad is valid for 28 days.

Interested? APPLY NOW!

Job Title: Metallurgical Technician (Metallurgical or Materials Technician - ANZSCO 312912) 
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, allied company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd 
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD, Australia 
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time 
Recruitment managed by: Yakr Pty Ltd

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a scientific delivery alliancing company created to provide professional and cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources Pty Ltd (Multicom). Scidell’s multi-disciplined scientific and technical project professionals operate from Brisbane and on-site to deliver major projects from initial study through to execution, commissioning, and ongoing expert operational support. 

Multicom is on a mission to bring high-purity critical minerals to the world and become a reliable supplier for global technology manufacturers. Currently, Multicom is progressing the permitting, approval, and development of its 100% owned Saint Elmo Project, situated 25 km east of Julia Creek in Queensland's Northwest Minerals Province , focused on advancing the production of critical assets like vanadium and high-purity alumina (HPA). 

About the role:
As a Metallurgical Technician at Scidell, you will be a key member of the production and operations team responsible for monitoring and improving metallurgical performance targets for the Saint Elmo refinery and mine facility. Working under the direct supervision of the Process Supervisor, you will test materials, operate equipment, and optimize processes to ensure safe, efficient plant operations. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to apply technical data analysis and hands-on testing skills within a highly sophisticated minerals processing environment. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Process Optimization & Monitoring: Monitor various stages of the production process to ensure smooth operations. Check and adjust parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow rates, and chemical concentrations to maximize plant throughput, Vanadium/HPA recovery, and quality costs. 
•	Metallurgical Testing & Surveys: Undertake surveys, coordinate sampling activities, and execute test work to evaluate and identify process improvement opportunities. 
•	Equipment Operations: Start up, shut down, adjust, and operate plant machinery and equipment safely in strict accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
•	Equipment & Lab Performance: Monitor key equipment across both the process plant and the onsite laboratory to ensure components are optimized and alternative operational methods are assessed. 
•	Quality Control & Data Review: Conduct regular routine inspections and quality control checks on products and materials. Review operating and technical data to identify instances of noncompliance or opportunities for process optimization. 
•	Metallurgical Reporting: Maintain accurate records of equipment operations, process parameters, production, and testing activities. Generate precise metallurgical reconciliations and complete timely daily, weekly, and monthly reports. 
•	Troubleshooting & Technical Support: Identify and troubleshoot basic equipment issues, malfunctions, or process deviations. Provide expert technical support to operations, laboratory teams, and the senior process engineering team, collaborating closely on complex issues. 
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to the Site Safety and Health Management System and all established SOPs, ensuring all safety hazards or incidents are reported promptly. 

Key Requirements:
•	Education: Bachelor's degree in Extractive Metallurgy, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering. 
•	Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar metallurgical or materials testing role, with solid practical experience testing materials within a mineral/metal process and refinery environment. 
•	Licences: Possession of (or the immediate ability to acquire) a Radiation Safety Licence and a Queensland Driver’s Licence (manual preferred). 
•	Technical Skills: Sound understanding of process control systems , mechanical aptitude or a strong interest in hands-on technical roles , and a proven ability to source, gather, interpret, and communicate quantitative and qualitative data. 
•	Personal Attributes: Highly detail-oriented, safety-conscious, willing to learn, and possessing a reliable and consistent work ethic. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow technical instructions accurately. 
•	Pre-Employment Screening: Must be able to pass a comprehensive Pre-Employment Medical examination, including a drug and alcohol screen. 

Why join Scidell?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive, cooperative, and collaborative environment. Be part of a dedicated team that values safety, high attention to detail, and innovation in delivering critical minerals to global markets. 

How to Apply: 
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume/CV, ensuring you highlight your relevant material testing, metallurgical data analysis, and engineering experiences. 

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Engineering and Fabrication
•	Interpret technical engineering drawings, blueprints, and P&IDs to plan the fabrication and assembly of filtration systems, selecting correct materials and specialised tooling configurations.

•	Shape and finish customised stainless steel parts and skid frames by operating milling and lathe machines.
•	Weld stainless steel pipework, brackets, and structural frames for water treatment plant skids.
•	Select and fabricate high-pressure pipework and fittings (schedule-rated PVC, stainless, tri-clamp/flanged joints) to correct pressure ratings.
•	Assemble industrial water equipment by integrating manufactured components and aligning motor-pump subunits into fully functioning mechanical systems.
•	Assemble and overhaul industrial pumps (feed, transfer, high-pressure), fitting impellers, shafts, and mechanical seals.
Installation and Commissioning
•	Install and align high-pressure feed pumps, energy recovery devices, and couplings to spec.
•	Install and route fluid transfer systems by measuring, shaping, joining, and securing hydraulic, pneumatic, and process tubing.
•	Install pretreatment, micro/ultrafiltration, and reverse osmosis skids, including membrane and module fitment, manifold connections, and correct alignment.
•	Install multimedia filters, water softeners, and cartridge pre-filter housings, including resin bed setup and multiport/backwash valve configuration.
•	Install and calibrate chemical dosing systems (antiscalant, dechlorination, pH correction, coagulant/flocculant), including dosing pump setup and injection point plumbing.
•	Load, align, and torque RO membrane pressure vessels and elements to spec (membrane orientation, o-ring/interconnector fitment, end cap torque).

•	Fit and calibrate process instrumentation — pressure transmitters, flow meters, conductivity/TDS probes.

Service and Troubleshooting
•	Diagnose mechanical malfunctions, conduct preventive servicing, and restore performance of plant machinery.
•	Service and rebuild industrial pumps, replacing worn or damaged impellers, shafts, and mechanical seals.
•	Service multimedia filters, water softeners, and cartridge pre-filter housings, including resin bed servicing, backwash timing adjustment, and seal replacement.
•	Service and troubleshoot backwash, CEB, and CIP systems across pretreatment, MF/UF, and RO trains.
•	Troubleshoot and repair automated and manual valve faults (feed, reject, permeate-diversion, flush, air scour).
•	Troubleshoot and recalibrate process instrumentation to restore correct process control.

Electroplater positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufactures high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Electroplaters to be based at our NSW Office. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

Key Responsibilities:
Surface Preparation: Cleaning, degreasing, pickling, and etching metal parts to remove rust, scale, and oil, ensuring proper coating adhesion
Process Control: Setting up and operating plating machinery, including adjusting electrical currents (voltage/amperage), temperature, and immersion times
Chemical Management: Preparing, monitoring, and maintaining electrolytic solutions to the objects to be coated. Test and adjust plating solutions to maintain desired specifications
Quality Inspection: Inspecting finished products for defects (e.g., bubbles, uneven coverage) and measuring coating thickness using tools like micrometers
Equipment Maintenance: Cleaning tanks, maintaining hoists, and repairing machinery, such as replacing anodes or cleaning ventilation systems
Safety Compliance: Adhering strictly to health and safety regulations (PPE, chemical handling) due to exposure to hazardous materials and high temperatures

Required Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge, & Abilities:
Must have at least 3+ years of working experience in metal finishing or manufacturing environments
Relevant trade qualifications
Strong technical knowledge and understanding of metallurgy, chemical reactions, and corrosion protection
Knowledge of electroplating/ galvanising techniques and processes
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics
Physical ability to lift heavy metal products and operate machinery
Attention to Detail: Precision in monitoring, and inspecting to meet strict quality standards
Experience in maintaining electroplating/ galvanising equipment and troubleshooting issues
Strong knowledge of hazardous materials and safety equipment (respirators, protective clothing)
Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly skilled Database Developer to join a forward-thinking educational institution in Perth.   This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across SQL Server, integrations, reporting, and application development, with the opportunity to have a real impact on how data is used across the business.  
      This role sits at the heart of the Information and Learning Technologies team, where your technical expertise will directly support both business and academic operations. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions and digital applications that underpin the organisation's strategic goals. This position offers you the chance to work closely with stakeholders across the school community, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable technology outcomes. The role is perfect for someone who thrives in a supportive environment that values knowledge sharing, professional growth, and making a tangible impact on student wellbeing 
 
 Play a key role in shaping data-driven decision-making by developing integrated solutions that enhance accessibility, reporting, and analytics across the institution. 
 Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a collaborative team that values professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 Make a real difference by supporting student wellbeing and academic success through innovative use of technology and data intelligence. 
 
     
  Responsibilities:  
     
 
 Serve as the primary system administrator and subject-matter expert for the key projects, overseeing configuration, user management, data integrity, version upgrades, and module administration. 
 Design, maintain, and optimise database schemas and SQL Server infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability, security, and data quality across all systems. 
 Architect, develop, and manage integrations between core CRM platforms, finance systems, cloud identity providers, and communication tools using APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, and ETL processes. 
 Develop dashboards, reports, self-service analytics tools, and custom queries using platforms like Power BI, Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar to support strategic planning and operational needs. 
 Champion data quality frameworks by implementing profiling, cleansing, validation routines, and advising stakeholders on evidence-based decision-making. 
 Administer database change management processes including updates, release procedures, backup/recovery strategies while ensuring compliance with privacy legislation and organisational policies. 
 Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain custom web applications or internal tools using modern frameworks (Python/.NET/Node.js) aligned with the institution's technology stack. 
 Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments to gather requirements for digital solutions that extend enterprise system capabilities while ensuring secure coding practices are followed. 
 Create comprehensive technical documentation in partnership with key stakeholders; utilise ticketing systems for request tracking; document all changes thoroughly before implementation. 
 
 Mentor IT staff in best practices for database management and application development while staying abreast of emerging technologies. 
 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related discipline is essential for this role. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server technologies including T-SQL scripting, query optimisation techniques as well as experience with SSIS/SSRS or equivalent reporting tools is required. 
 Demonstrated ability to design API-based or middleware integrations (REST/SOAP/webhooks/ETL/Wonde) along with strong skills in ASP.NET/PowerShell/scripting languages is necessary. 
 Solid application development experience using one or more programming languages such as Python/C#/.NET/Node.js/PHP is expected. 
 Proven track record delivering business intelligence solutions using Power BI/Tableau/SSRS/Microsoft Fabric/Crystal Reports or similar platforms is highly valued. 
 Comprehensive understanding of data governance principles including privacy legislation (Australian Privacy Act/APP) plus information security best practices is mandatory. 
 Minimum five years experience in senior database administration or application development roles ideally within education or enterprise environments is preferred. 
 Excellent business analysis skills encompassing risk assessment solution design capabilities coupled with outstanding troubleshooting/problem-solving abilities are vital. 
 Exceptional communication skills enabling clear translation of technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders alongside proven stakeholder engagement experience are important attributes. 
 A positive outlook combined with willingness to embrace organisational values around service/integrity/stewardship plus demonstrated commitment to health & safety policies is expected. 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply.  
 To apply please click apply or call  Milena Wawrzyniak-Kalyanpur on +61 8 9266 0980 for a confidential discussion.
